Container.Name: AMA-Unraid
Container.Overview: AMA-Unraid is a community-maintained Unraid-focused fork of the archived RandomNinjaAtk/docker-ama project. AMA automates music archiving for use with Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Kodi, Roon, and Lidarr. Recommended mode is Deemix Direct, which runs Deemix inside the AMA container and uses /downloads-ama/temp as a safe per-album working folder. Use only with content and accounts you are authorized to access.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent AMA configuration, scripts, logs, cache, lists, and deemix data.

Config.Name: Downloads / Music Library
Config.Description: Final processed music library. AMA also manages /downloads-ama/temp internally as the safe per-album Deemix Direct working folder. Do not map /downloads-ama/temp separately.

Config.Name: Download Client
Config.Description: Download backend. Recommended: deemix_direct. This runs Deemix inside AMA and downloads each album directly into /downloads-ama/temp before AMA post-processing. Legacy option: deemix_api.

Config.Name: Legacy Deemix API URL
Config.Description: Legacy only. URL for an external Deemix WebUI/API container when DOWNLOAD_CLIENT=deemix_api. Not used by recommended Deemix Direct mode.

Config.Name: Deemix Config Path In Container
Config.Description: Container path where Deemix login.json is mounted. Required for Deemix Direct unless ARL_TOKEN is set. Leave as /deemix-config unless you changed the path mapping.

Config.Name: Deemix Direct Queue Concurrency
Config.Description: Internal Deemix Direct queue/download concurrency. Recommended 1 because AMA uses /downloads-ama/temp as a per-album working folder.

Config.Name: Legacy Deemix Download Path In Container
Config.Description: Legacy only. Container path where external Deemix API downloads are mounted when DOWNLOAD_CLIENT=deemix_api. Not used by recommended Deemix Direct mode.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership. 99 is the default Unraid nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership. 100 is the default Unraid users group.

Config.Name: Autostart
Config.Description: true = run AMA automatically on container startup. false = manual runs only. Recommended to keep false until your configuration is tested.

Config.Name: Script Interval
Config.Description: Amount of time between script runs when AUTOSTART=true. Examples: 15m, 1h, 1d.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: Download mode. Common values are artist or discography.

Config.Name: ARL Token
Config.Description: Optional Deemix Direct login fallback. Recommended setup is to mount /deemix-config with a valid login.json. Keep this private. Use only with accounts/content you are authorized to access.

Config.Name: Related Artist
Config.Description: Enable related artist discovery from your artist list. Leave false for a safer first setup.

Config.Name: Related Artist Related
Config.Description: Enable recursive related artist discovery. Warning: this can greatly expand processing.

Config.Name: Related Count
Config.Description: Maximum related artists to import per artist.

Config.Name: Fan Count
Config.Description: Minimum fan count required for related artist processing.

Config.Name: Concurrent Downloads
Config.Description: AMA album processing concurrency. Recommended 1 for Deemix Direct because /downloads-ama/temp is cleaned and reused per album.

Config.Name: Embedded Cover Quality
Config.Description: Embedded cover image quality percentage. 100 = no compression.

Config.Name: Format
Config.Description: Target audio format. Common values: FLAC, ALAC, AAC, MP3, OPUS.

Config.Name: Bitrate
Config.Description: Target bitrate for lossy conversion when applicable.

Config.Name: Force Convert
Config.Description: Force conversion to requested format when supported. Recommended false for Deemix Direct.

Config.Name: Post Process Threads
Config.Description: Number of threads used for format conversion and ReplayGain tagging.

Config.Name: Album Type Filter
Config.Description: Album types to skip/filter. Example: COMPILE, SINGLE, ALBUM, EP.

Config.Name: Require Quality
Config.Description: Require downloaded files to match the target file extension/quality.

Config.Name: ReplayGain
Config.Description: Enable ReplayGain scanning/tagging.

Config.Name: Ignore Artist Without Image
Config.Description: Skip artists with default/non-unique images.

Config.Name: Complete My Artists
Config.Description: Add artist IDs found in the library that are not already in your list. Leave false unless you understand the workflow.

Config.Name: File Permissions
Config.Description: File permissions applied to processed files.

Config.Name: Folder Permissions
Config.Description: Folder permissions applied to processed folders.

Config.Name: Lidarr List Import
Config.Description: true = import artist list from Lidarr.

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: Lidarr URL. Only used when LIDARR_LIST_IMPORT=true. Example: http://10.13.1.138:8686

Config.Name: Lidarr API Key
Config.Description: Lidarr API key. Only used when LIDARR_LIST_IMPORT=true.

Config.Name: Notify Plex
Config.Description: true = notify Plex after changes. Plex must have a library using the same media path.

Config.Name: Plex Scan Path Override
Config.Description: Optional. Path Plex sees for the same folder AMA writes to /downloads-ama. Example: /media/music. Leave blank if Plex also uses /downloads-ama.

Config.Name: Plex Library Name
Config.Description: Exact Plex music library name. Only used when NOTIFYPLEX=true.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Plex server URL. Only used when NOTIFYPLEX=true.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex token. Only used when NOTIFYPLEX=true.

Config.Name: Deemix Config
Config.Description: Host path containing Deemix login.json. Required for Deemix Direct unless ARL_TOKEN is set.

Config.Name: Legacy Deemix Downloads
Config.Description: Legacy only. External Deemix API downloads folder for DOWNLOAD_CLIENT=deemix_api. Not used by recommended Deemix Direct mode.
